title: TDS — official race page (2026 edition)
claims: The 2026 TDS starts in Courmayeur on Monday 24 August 2026 at 23:50 and finishes in Chamonix.
The official TDS stat block lists 145 km, 9,500 m of positive gain and 4 Running Stones.
The maximum allowed race time is 44 hours 55 minutes.
The official page describes a route through the Beaufortain massif and Hauteluce, including Fort de la Platte, Cormet de Roselend, Passeur de Pralognan and Col Chavannes.
The official page says the 2027 edition is in preparation at the time of access.

verification.note: Official English page read; stat block, date, start time, time limit and 2027 notice are in the page body.
